title: Comprehensive subregion question matching across Africa, Asia, and the Americas
body:
REGIONAL QUESTION UNDERSTANDING
- Added full coverage for African subregions (Southern Africa, Northern Africa, Western Africa, Eastern Africa, and Middle/Central Africa) in English and Polish.
- Supported both Polish adjective-noun word orders for all Asian and European subregions (e.g. "południowa Azja" and "Azja Południowa").
- Added inflected forms for Middle East ("Bliskiego Wschodu", "Bliskim Wschodem"), Central America ("Ameryka Środkowa"), and Baltic states ("państwo bałtyckie").
- Expanded regional trigger phrases to recognize questions asking about country origin and statehood.
